snippet.title: Full Metal Daemon Muramasa - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Published by JAST USA
Developed by Nitroplus
Release Date: August 24, 2021

The Nitroplus 10th Anniversary title is now available in English!

This is not a story of heroes.

Set in an alternate post-WWII Japan, Full Metal Daemon Muramasa paints a vivid picture of a world where suits of enchanted, flying armor are the ultimate weapon. Amid political machinations and the resurgent threat of war, a cast of deadly, driven men and women each seek the one Way that will satisfy the demand of their soul.

What is evil? What is justice? What is the purpose of vengeance? Of might?

And when these questions are answered, who will be left standing?
